text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite running with every ounce of 
strength she had, Mejiro Dober was left 
dejected after painfully realizing the gap 
in power between herself and the Senior 
Class racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Arima Kinen. While 
watching a Classic-tier recap show on TV 
together with Mejiro Dober—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The broadcasted program did not center on 
Mejiro Dober, who excelled in the Classic 
Class, but instead looked back and praised 
the past glories of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that she is still far from 
becoming "the new glory of Mejiro," Mejiro 
Dober expresses her frustration. Yet, her 
spirit has not given up just yet...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding the vow she made with Mejiro 
Bright close to her heart, Mejiro Dober 
set out to make her comeback at the Osaka 
Hai, taking her next step forward once 
again!
